summary: Tested the IVA giroconto (LI) and the year closing/opening (CH/AP) with year lock, backend and frontend. New pytest file test_iteration32_chiusure.py: 20 of 21 pass. Regression test_iteration31_contabilita.py: 23 of 23 pass. Checked and working: liquidazioni mensile/trimestrale amounts, 1% interest, LI entry rows and date, duplicate/overlap/empty/invalid-period rejections (overlapping periods flagged as bloccato), LI entries can't be changed via /registrazioni, cancelling and re-registering an LI. Chiusura: motivo blocks (current year, previous year not closed, already closed), 6 balanced entries in the preview with party rows, closing locks the year (manual POST/PUT/DELETE, liquidazione POST/DELETE, passive delete, bank unreconcile all rejected; bank auto-registration in a closed year fails silently with 200 and no entry), annulla blocked when the next year is closed, annulla unlocks, operatore gets 403, mastrino balance carries over between years, year-range bilancio with and without closing entries. Frontend: liq-coge card registra/annulla/stato and blocked periods, Chiusura page (conferma disabled until the preview is open, then close -> Chiuso + 6 entries + annulla), the Liquidazione card shows read-only after closing, prima nota shows the Apertura badge with no edit/delete buttons, 2026 shows its motivo. One bug found: a bilancio without dates (or spanning several years) counts the patrimonial accounts twice.

minor.endpoint: GET /api/contabilita/bilancio (no dal/al, or a range spanning more than one year)
minor.issue: Opening (apertura) entries are included and only chiusura entries are excluded, so the patrimonial balances of the closed year plus the reopening of the next year are added together. Reproduced: closed year attivita 2108.90 -> unfiltered bilancio attivita 4217.80. Fix: when the range covers a closed year N and the year N+1, also exclude the apertura entries of N+1 (or the chiusura of N plus the apertura in the range), or force the bilancio to a single year.

Opening entries take the next free number of year N+1 (e.g. 3/2026, 4/2026 when 2026 entries already exist) instead of coming first in the journal. The counter is never reset, so numbering has gaps after cancelling LI/CH entries (seen LI n.9 and CH n.10-13 after cancel/redo). Cosmetic for the libro giornale.

Accounts of type attivita with a credit balance (e.g. 05.02.001 Erario c/IVA owing 111.10 after a liquidation at debit) are closed and reopened inside the 'attivi' entries. The result balances, but the presentation is unusual. Also stato() only checks year-1 for entries; a gap year (entries in N-2, none in N-1) lets N close while N-2 is still open.

issues: Year selector chiusura-anno-select is a native <select>, while the Liquidazione IVA page uses the shadcn Select: inconsistent look
The total in each entry header is the dare total (e.g. 11.220,00 for 'attivi'), which includes the counter-entry; this can be confusing
Periods with no IVA show 'Da registrare' but have no button; 'Nessuna IVA' would be clearer

action_items: Fix bilancio double counting when the date filter is empty or spans more than one year (exclude apertura entries of year N+1 when year N is in range, or require a single year)
Optional: give opening entries the first numbers of the new year; label zero-IVA periods 'Nessuna IVA'; use the shadcn Select for the Chiusura year selector
critical_code_review_comments: contabilita.bilancio: the filter excludes origine 'chiusura' but always includes 'apertura', which is wrong for multi-year ranges

contabilita_chiusure.chiudi: no concurrency guard (two parallel POSTs could both pass stato() before the coge_chiusi update; the unique ref_id index makes the second _insert return None, but coge_chiusi is still added). Low risk.
contabilita_chiusure.stato: the previous-year check only looks at anno-1
Prima nota/Chiusura show the new origini badges correctly; LI/CH/AP entries are protected from edit/delete through /registrazioni
seed_data_creation: The pytest suite creates and removes its own TEST_T32 company, users and records (cleanup verified). On 'TEST_Chiusura Srl' (cid in /tmp/cid2) the UI test cancelled and re-registered the Q1 trimestrale LI (now entry n.9/2025), then closed and reopened 2025. Final state is the same as before: 2025 open, Q1 LI registered.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: cd /app/backend/tests && pytest test_iteration32_chiusure.py test_iteration31_contabilita.py -n 0. test_11_bilancio_all_years_not_doubled fails until the bilancio apertura double count is fixed. Synthetic passive_invoices docs need fornitore and numero_display, otherwise the banca import/_ledger_passive raises a KeyError (test artifact, not an app bug). The current date is 2026-11, so only 2025 or earlier can be closed.
rca of the issue: bilancio(): f = {... 'origine': {'$ne': 'chiusura'}}. With no dates, the year-N entries (excluding chiusura) are summed together with the apertura entries of N+1, which repeat the same patrimonial balances, so attivita and passivita double. Mitigation: exclude apertura entries dated in the range whenever the previous year's entries are also in the range.
